items.title: Over a separably closed field the tensor product of two algebras with a unique minimal prime has one too
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that over a separably closed field the tensor product of two algebras each having a unique minimal prime again has a unique minimal prime (statement lines 11322-11327). The proof does not argue with minimal primes directly: it passes to the perfect closure, which is algebraically closed under the hypothesis, proves irreducibility of the fibres in that case, and applies the criterion for flat ring maps with irreducible fibres to the tensor product (proof lines 11329-11360). Passing to the perfect closure so that the field becomes algebraically closed is the step that simplifies the geometry. H2.
